title: Systems: Procedures for Worker Voice
description: Roll-out of independent worker voice channels alongside company mechanisms.

title: Communications: Worker Voice Channels
description: Language-appropriate communication to workers regarding grievance access.

title: Capacity Building: Ethical Grievance Training
description: Issara Academy training (online/in-person) on the 8 key components of grievance mechanisms.

title: Activity: Worker Satisfaction Surveys
description: Periodic independent or internal surveys to gauge worker morale and risks.

title: Activity: Outreach & Education
description: Direct education for workers on rights, contracts, and payment terms.

title: Systems: Procedures for Ethical Recruitment
description: Strengthening contracts (MSAs) and vetting criteria for recruitment agencies.

title: Communications: Agency Disclosure
description: Transparency by suppliers to buyers regarding all recruitment agencies used.

title: Capacity Building: Ethical Recruitment Training
description: Issara Academy training for managers on practical recruitment business tools. Covers Ethical Recruitment 101 & 201: from first-mile recruitment systems to worker voice-driven approaches and the Golden Dreams Marketplace.

title: Activity: Golden Dreams Platform
description: Use of the Golden Dreams app for transparent, electronic recruitment and job offers.

title: Activity: Recruitment Surveys
description: Site-level surveys to identify hidden recruitment fees and system weaknesses.

title: Activity: Recruitment Fee Repayment
description: Verifiable, timely repayment of recruitment fees to eligible workers.

title: Activity: Feedback Loop to Workers
description: Effective, language-appropriate communication to workers about continuous improvement being made in response to worker feedback.

title: Capacity Building: Business and Human Rights / HRDD
description: Issara Academy training for managers and working-level staff on HRDD and going beyond audit: the significance of Human Rights Due Diligence in supply chains, with focus on practical approaches and emerging EU & U.S. requirements.

title: Capacity Building: Interpreters and Line Supervisors
description: Issara Academy training for interpreters and line supervisors: ethical approaches to working with migrant workers, applicable labor-related policies, and strengthening grievance mechanisms and workplace systems.

title: Capacity Building: Management & Leadership
description: Issara Academy training for management on ethical grievance mechanisms, remediation, and ongoing coaching. Includes Ethics & Guidelines for Worker Welfare Committee Members.

title: Action: Worker Satisfaction Survey
description: Roll-out of periodic independent worker satisfaction surveys with comparative analysis of internal vs. independent results.

title: Activity: Wages in Context Analysis
description: Analysis of minimum wage, adequate wage, premiums, targets, deductions, and other factors with WageIndicator data and technical support to inform CSRD reporting, company policies, and purchasing agreements.

title: Systems: Wage Transparency
description: Development of digital/printed wage slips and "Wage Literacy" sessions for workers.

title: WageIndicator Data Access
description: Annual subscription to living wage data for 208 countries and 10,000 industries.

title: Activity: Feedback on Pay
description: Effective communication to workers regarding pay structures. Use worker satisfaction surveys to verify wages are sufficient for basic needs.

title: Activity: Wage Gap Analysis & Disclosure
description: Transparent analysis and disclosure of wage gaps to facilitate buyer negotiations.

title: Systems: Heat-Responsive Protocols
description: Implementation of the "Water, Rest, Shade" protocol with scheduled paid rest time in cooling areas and acclimatization programs for new workers.

title: Activity: Heat Risk Assessment and Monitoring
description: Conduct thorough, ongoing heat risk assessments at all work sites and dormitories.

title: Capacity Building: Heat Safety Training
description: Training for managers, line supervisors, and workers on recognizing signs of heat stress and administering first aid.

title: Activity: Infrastructure & Gear
description: Investment in cooling areas, ventilation, and climate-safe uniforms. Ensure company-provided living spaces are equipped with adequate cooling.

title: Policy: Worker Voice / Ethical Grievance Mechanisms
description: Establish or strengthen ethical grievance policies with zero-tolerance for retaliation.

title: Policy: Ethical / Responsible Recruitment
description: Establish or assess national/partner policies for ethical hiring.

title: Policy: Ethical Sourcing Roadmap
description: Establish company policies on ethical working conditions, including a zero-tolerance issues list, remediation timelines, and international standards conformance.

title: Policy: Living Wage Roadmap
description: Commitment to living wage benchmarks (e.g., Anker) and a roadmap to close the wage gap.

title: Policy: Extreme Heat Protection
description: Integrate heat protection as a core element of ethical sourcing and OHS policies. Establish "Stop Work" authorities for dangerous heat thresholds.

title: Activity: Multi-Stakeholder Meeting (ACTIVITY)
description: Online and in-person multi-stakeholder discussions to encourage analysis and exchange on social responsibility and social compliance in supply chains.

title: Ethical Recruitment 101
description: Online group course to strengthen recruitment systems, verify worker recruitment experiences, reduce business risk, and improve worker retention through case studies and policy analysis.

title: Ethical Recruitment 201
description: Practical tools to support worker-voice approaches to ethical recruitment, including vetting and contracting tools and tech-driven solutions.

title: Social Compliance and HRDD: Going beyond audit
description: Online course on the significance and benefits of going beyond audit for HRDD, focusing on practical approaches and emerging requirements.

title: Ethical Grievance Mechanisms 101
description: Online course exploring the key elements of ethical grievance mechanisms and their implementation in working and recruitment environments.

title: Ethical Grievance Mechanisms 201
description: Practical tools and approaches for self-assessing and strengthening company grievance mechanisms, aligned to HRDD principles.

title: Ethics & Guidelines for Line Supervisors
description: Training to equip line supervisors with an understanding of labor-related policies and ethical supervising approaches, especially for migrant workers.

title: Ethics & Guidelines for Interpreters
description: Training for interpreters on labor-related policies and ethical approaches when mediating between migrant workers and management.

title: Ethics & Guidelines for Worker Welfare Committee Members
description: Session exploring challenges for worker representatives, business & human rights principles, and case studies to strengthen workplace systems.

title: CASCADE Community Onboarding
description: Learn how worker voice data and systems empower stakeholders and how the CASCADE Community and Action Network operate.

title: Human rights and global trade compliance requirements for EU & U.S. markets
description: Learn about emerging requirements like the EU FLR and U.S. 21CCF and how CASCADE data supports market access for high-risk goods.
